**1.2 Aim and Objectives**

This project aims to examine the fire flammability of bio-plastic materials when exposed to fire and to investigate the possibility of modifying their composition in order to improve fire resistance, with the aim of considering bio-plastics as a potential alternative to conventional plastics.

**This aim will be achieved through the following:**

1.2.1 Selecting suitable bio-plastic samples for the purpose of the study.

1.2.2 Preparing bio-plastic materials and applying compositional modifications to enhance their fire resistance.

1.2.3 Conducting fire-related tests to evaluate the flammability behavior of bio-plastic materials before and after modification.

1.2.4 Comparing the fire response of modified bio-plastics with that of conventional plastics.

**1.3 Literature Review**
